edges.mechanism: Both products deliver butyrate (tributyrin via lipase hydrolysis; ProButyrate as sustained-release butyric acid). Stacking duplicates exposure; tributyrin GI adverse effects (nausea, vomiting, cramping, odor) were dose-related in phase I, and oral butyrate raised blood pressure in an RCT.
edges.evidence: No combination study; inference from phase I tributyrin toxicity, sodium butyrate BP RCT (n=23) and prodrug review; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Inulin increases endogenous colonic butyrate production (+44% by stable-isotope tracer) and plasma butyrate in older adults; butyrate plus inulin lowered fasting glucose within-group in T2D where neither alone did.
edges.evidence: Tracer RCT (n=61) and 4-arm RCTs in T2D (n=60); additive butyrate supply; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Fiber/prebiotic RCTs raise fecal butyrate modestly (SMD 0.24) and fructans/GOS raise Bifidobacterium; but GOS 16 g/d reduced butyrate-producing Ruminococcus and raised fasting glucose in a short crossover. Net butyrate effect of combination unpredictable.
edges.evidence: SR/MA of 64 fiber RCTs plus 14-day crossover RCT (n=35); low certainty

edges.mechanism: Acarbose increases starch reaching the colon, raising fecal butyrate proportion (22-28 vs 18-19 mol/100 mol) and serum butyrate (4.2 vs 2.6 uM); combined with tributyrin increases total butyrate exposure; both may lower glucose.
edges.evidence: Human crossover RCT and 4-month RCT for acarbose; no combination study; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Metformin raised serum butyrate at 6 months (while reducing Roseburia); sodium butyrate improved CGM time-in-tight-range and HbA1c in small T2D RCTs. Possible small additive glycemic effect and additive butyrate exposure.
edges.evidence: RCT of metformin (n=121) and small butyrate RCTs in T2D; no interaction study; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Oral sodium butyrate lowered fasting glucose/HbA1c/HOMA-IR in some small RCTs (within or between group); additive glucose lowering possible but small and inconsistent.
edges.evidence: Small RCTs (n=42-60) with inconsistent between-group results; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Oral sodium butyrate for 4 weeks increased daytime ambulatory SBP by 9.63 mmHg (95% CI 2.02-17.20) and DBP by 5.08 mmHg vs placebo in hypertensive patients off medication; plasma butyrate rose. A T2D trial showed only within-group BP falls.
edges.evidence: Double-blind RCT (n=23) contradicting rodent data; not tested with tributyrin; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Butyrate raised BP in untreated hypertension and could oppose antihypertensive therapy; not studied with medication on board.
edges.evidence: Single RCT (n=23) with medication washed out; extrapolated; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Colonic butyrate is the main colonocyte fuel and is impaired in UC; adding sodium butyrate 4 g/d to oral mesalazine produced greater improvement vs baseline (between-arm difference not significant).
edges.evidence: Pilot RCT (n=30) plus SR of UC trials; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Oral tributyrin expanded regulatory T cells and prolonged allograft survival in mice; human oral butyrate did not change immune phenotype in T1D. Clinical relevance to immunosuppressed transplant patients unknown.
edges.evidence: Preclinical transplant models plus null human crossover RCT (n=30); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Tributyrin upregulated the vitamin D receptor and synergized with calcitriol on growth inhibition/differentiation in Caco-2 cells; a calcium butyrate + zinc + vitamin D3 formula improved fatty liver index vs placebo in MASLD.
edges.evidence: In vitro mechanistic study plus one combination-product RCT (n=50); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Tributyrin requires pancreatic lipase hydrolysis to release butyrate; reduced lipase may reduce or shift activation.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic (in vitro digestion model and prodrug review); no clinical data; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Oral butyrate as adjunct improved CD activity and fecal calprotectin in adults, but showed no efficacy in pediatric IBD; enemas showed no consistent benefit.
edges.evidence: RCTs (n=140, n=72) and SRs; very low to low certainty

edges.mechanism: Exogenous butyrate raises plasma/serum butyrate (transiently, peaking within 60 min), confounding serum SCFA used as a marker of microbial fermentation.
edges.evidence: RCTs and acute PK study; physiological confounding rather than assay artifact; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Triglycerides increased with tributyrin complex 400 mg/d in healthy adults but decreased with sodium butyrate in T2D; direction formulation- and population-dependent.
edges.evidence: Pilot (n=24) and RCT (n=46); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Sodium butyrate lowered fecal calprotectin in active UC and CD (true anti-inflammatory change), which may shift IBD monitoring values.
